NoteWorkshop



Prerequisites
If you are planning to participate in the workshop, you should bring:

A laptop
If you don’t have a computer you can bring, please contact Eric Rowley (Blanding) or Don Busenbark (Roosevelt) to arrange to use a loaner laptop.
R and RStudio software (see instructions below)


Software Installation Instructions

Download and install the latest R version first, and then download and install RStudio.
Open RStudio from your applications menu. In the Console (bottom left) pane, type install.packages("tidyverse") and hit enter.

You should be good to go! If you encounter any issues, please contact Susan Vanderplas and she can help you resolve any errors or set you up with an alternate means to use R and RStudio through the browser.
